chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from Ali from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Mu'awiya ibn 'Ammar from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The Imam prays Dhuhr on the day of al-Nafar in Mecca.

key_terms.يَوْمَ النَّفْرِ: The day of al-Nafar (the day of departure from Mina during Hajj)

ai.seo_question: Where and when does the Imam pray Dhuhr on the day of al-Nafar during Hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the procedural detail of the Hajj rites by specifying that the Imam leads the Dhuhr prayer in Mecca on the day of al-Nafar, distinguishing it from the combined prayers in Mina. This ruling is significant for understanding the spatial and temporal logistics of the pilgrimage, ensuring the faithful follow the Imam's lead in the sacred precincts before the final departure. It reflects the scholarly emphasis on precise adherence to the Prophet's and Imams' practices during the critical days of Dhu al-Hijjah.
